name: PICC Property and Casualty Company Limited
summary: PICC Property and Casualty Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in property and casualty insurance business in People's Republic of China. It operates through six segments: motor vehicle, accidental injury and health, agriculture, Liability, Commercial Property, and Other. The company offers motor vehicle, commercial property, cargo, liability, accidental injury, short-term health, agriculture, credit, surety, household property, marine hull, and other insurance products.
